paragraphs.text: Jenara is the Asura Angel of war and strife, who has become the de facto leader of the seven Asura during the war that ravaged Alara after the Conflux .

On Bant , seven angels, the Asura, form the highest angelic court, higher than the Amesha and lesser angels such as celebrants. Jenara has become the most important of all her Asura sisters, who have ruled Bant's angels during Asha 's absence. She is left-handed.

Jenara quickly made an impact in the war, becoming one of Bant's foremost weapons against the invading hordes at its borders. When she fights, she is so focused on the foe to ignore everyone around her, even wounded soldiers grateful for her appearance.
